text: たたかい　おわっても　まひは　のこります　また　まひなおしで　なおります

structure.jp: たたかい　おわっても
まひは　のこります
まひなおしで　なおります
structure.en: it is cured with a Paralyze Heal

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after the て-form of a verb says 'even if' or 'even after' that happens, the next thing is still true. たたかい　おわっても = 'even after the battle ends'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.span: まひなおしで　なおります
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is what you use to get it done. まひなおしで　なおります = 'it is cured with a Paralyze Heal'.
